performance_claim_scope: engine-level packed AR decode (gguf_packed_ar_bench.py), same-host W7900 gfx1100 device 0; not the canonical production HTTP topline (separate protocol)
hardware: AMD Radeon Pro W7900 gfx1100 (48 GiB), therock env, rocm 7.2.4

protocol.timing: synchronized model-step completion latency per native group

change: Enable native_batch_decode_session(2<=rows<=4) in Qwen35GGUFResidentSession._enqueue_packed_decode_model_step so the packed c2/c4 decode selects the exact dense_rowtile t16 decode kernel (reads existing tiles) instead of the slow t16_wmma_prefill GEMM. +1 line in hipengine/runtime/qwen35_gguf_runner.py.
root_cause: packed decode step was missing native_batch_decode_session (present in sibling _enqueue_native_rows_model), so _native_batch_decode_session_enabled was False and the exact rowtile sidecar decode was skipped -> fell back to t16_wmma_prefill (~130-150 GB/s, 120.5 ms/step for FFN).

correctness.note: c2/c4 trajectories are prefix-exact to the independent c1 oracle -> batch-composition invariance preserved (not gamed). dense_rowtile is arithmetically exact.

before_fix_engine_level.note: pre-fix same protocol (t16_wmma_prefill decode) measured earlier this session

limitations: native_c8 (rows=8) not covered: rowtile sidecar is rows 2-4 only; rows 8 hits pre-existing qmicro planar rowtile rows[2,4] limit (task #11 pending).
Canonical production HTTP packet (benchmarks/README concurrency2 table) uses a different protocol; re-run needed to capture the topline HTTP improvement.
